rows.text: Resolution S.O. 1207(E), dated New Delhi, 25 July 2007: Smt. Pratibha Devisingh Patil, having been elected President of the Republic of India, takes her seat as President of India under a salute of 21 guns.

locator.item: MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS RESOLUTION, S.O. 1207(E), first paragraph (Hindi: page 1)

rows.text: The Proclamation ordered by the same resolution notifies that Smt. Pratibha Devisingh Patil, having been elected as the President of India, has entered upon the said Office, and orders it sent to the principal military stations, Indian missions abroad, 62 ministries and offices and the 35 State and Union Territory governments and administrators [F. No. 2/4/2007-Public].

locator.item: RESOLUTION, PROCLAMATION and ORDER, and the lists continuing on page 4 (Hindi: pages 1-2)

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
